messages:
Lina Gomez: hey all, lina here (day 2). my PR triggered CI but failed on the first step. getting a weird 'agent not authenticated' from Buildkite and GH Actions shows I can't run workflows. who do I ping for onboarding CI perms + SSO?
Buildkite Bot: Build #9 (lina/add-logger) failed · exit code 1 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/9
Lina Gomez: build checkout error: 
```
Error: agent not authorized: no user session found for lina.gomez@redwood.com
```
Priya Patel: welcome Lina! :wave: did you finish the SSO sign-in flow and enable 2FA? We require SAML SSO + 2FA for Buildkite and GitHub org access. Also check you accepted the GitHub org invite.
Lina Gomez: i clicked the invite but when i try to open the Actions tab I get "You don’t have permissions to view or run actions on this repository." I completed Okta SSO login earlier but maybe missed something.
Samir Rao: hi @Lina, sometimes the order matters: you need to sign-in to Okta, then go to GitHub and re-auth the SAML session, and finally accept the org invite while signed-in. i'll check org membership and pipeline teams.
Infra Oncall: FYI we saw a batch of new hires whose accounts were created before the org SSO enforcement window closed; they must re-auth to mount access tokens. Raising INC-2025-17 if this is a broader issue.
Lina Gomez: doing the Okta re-auth now...
Samir Rao: i see you in IdP but not yet in the "eng-ci" GitHub team. Adding you to eng-ci and to the Buildkite pipeline team now. Also granting your account access to the CI secrets vault for repo:secret/ci-gcp-key (docs repo restricts secrets to eng-ci).
GitHub Actions Bot: Permission update: user Lina Gomez added to team eng-ci (org: redwood-inference)
Lina Gomez: re-ran the Buildkite job and now it's past checkout but failing during deploy step complaining about missing service account JSON: 
```
ERROR: could not find secret: secrets.GCP_SA_KEY
```
Priya Patel: pipelines access secrets from the internal Vault via team bindings. I added a note in the onboarding doc to request "repo secrets" access for infra changes. For now I'll grant the specific secret to your pipeline run so you can proceed.
Samir Rao: granted secrets.GCP_SA_KEY to the pipeline run and re-triggered. Also set a small guard so docs-only PRs don't get granted access automatically.
Lina Gomez: thanks — build progressed further but now a unit test failed complaining about flaky timeouts (test expects 200 but gets 504).
Priya Patel: that flake is from the staging mock service; for early PRs you can use the env var MOCKS=local to stub services, or add label "ci:fast" to skip slow integration stages.
Lina Gomez: added label ci:fast and retried, build went green. Build link: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/11
Buildkite Bot: Build #11 (lina/add-logger) passed · duration 8m · https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/11
Lina Gomez: phew, green. two quick onboarding Qs: 1) for other repos using GitHub Actions, do I need repo admin to enable the Actions app? 2) how do I request CI secrets for a PR?
Samir Rao: 1) to enable the GitHub App or Actions you need to be a repo admin or ask a repo maintainer; if you can't access the Actions tab, ping eng-infra and we'll check the app install. 2) for secrets open a short request in #eng-infra with the repo + secret name + justification; secrets are granted to pipelines, not individual users, and we require a reason and expiration for access.
Priya Patel: adding to onboarding checklist: re-auth Okta SSO after you accept org invite, verify 2FA, confirm eng-ci team membership, and file secrets request if you need access.
Lina Gomez: adding that to my checklist now. thanks everyone for the quick help — saved my first-week panic :relieved:
Samir Rao: welcome aboard! ping us if anything else blocks editing infra/ci-templates or enabling workflows.
